source_probability_method: Whole source clusters, all queries/repeats kept together; Beta(1,1) shrinkage, 2000 bootstrap draws, lower10th percentile. Development estimator, not a formal risk bound.
scope: Development predictor only. Actual prospective efficacy and complete wall must be measured separately.
calibration_boundary: All R3 is observed development. Prefix state uses an earlier issued same stable hash, which is observable before dispatch; actual hit/miss is an audited outcome, never used as an online oracle. Costs include observed misses. New policy may change the state distribution; live validation is required.
